svg.title: Installing only the source publication component — A complete project cannot be replaced by a component install
svg.text: Installing only the source publication component
Scenario: A complete project cannot be replaced by a component install
The project already has a framework and its own choices
Choose the component and receive a safe refusal

g.text: Given a project that carries no framework at all
A fresh clone provides the same real installer terminal as the component journey. The next
step generates the complete framework with the working template before attempting
installation.
And that project was generated with the complete framework and its own
Copier choices
This is a real Copier render with the complete install scope, Podman, an enabled project
workspace, and source publication disabled. The answers are generated by Copier, not written
by the test.
The executable tool and private file are also present. The test records the entire project's
file hashes, inventory and permissions, excluding Git's internal directory.
When the developer ticks source publication on the checklist
The developer chooses source publication in the real installer checklist. That choice must
not replace the answers or copy any part of the component into an existing complete project.
Then the installer refuses the component install and explains how to
update the existing project
The installer must return a failure before copying files. Its own session log records the
exit status and explains how to enable publication through the existing project's update
mechanism.
And the complete project keeps every original file and permission
without gaining a component copy
The real answer values, file hashes, permissions and tool execution are inspected again. The
assertions compare every original file and directory with the initial state, and reject
extra files as well as overwritten files.
